legend: You are given a node of the tree with index 1 and with weight 0. Let cnt be the number of nodes in the tree at any instant (initially, cnt is set to 1). Support Q queries of following two types:
![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3c53d1886cd6252f58663221e2b5768b1981acff.png) Add a new node (index cnt + 1) with weight W and add edge between node R and this node.
![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3ca7b8a948d44b13bf24c54f54602fe3dbc94f6d.png) Output the maximum length of sequence of nodes which   starts with R.
Every node in the sequence is an ancestor of its predecessor.
Sum of weight of nodes in sequence does not exceed X.
For some nodes i, j that are consecutive in the sequence if i is an ancestor of j then w[i] ≥ w[j] and there should not exist a node k on simple path from i to j such that w[k] ≥ w[j]
The tree is rooted at node 1 at any instant.
Note that the queries are given in a modified way.
input: First line containing the number of queries Q (1 ≤ Q ≤ 400000).
Let last be the answer for previous query of type 2 (initially last equals 0).
Each of the next Q lines contains a query of following form:

1 p q (1 ≤ p, q ≤ 1018): This is query of first type where ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/23caaf5370a4d35b830e404cf70088925e1a9749.png) and ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/92f7f390372274897cb1fbe68b8e5fcbbbd9710c.png). It is guaranteed that 1 ≤ R ≤ cnt and 0 ≤ W ≤ 109.

2 p q (1 ≤ p, q ≤ 1018): This is query of second type where ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/23caaf5370a4d35b830e404cf70088925e1a9749.png) and ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/07ae7521dbc6857c85e4d6cc6df38a9db5a96d28.png). It is guaranteed that 1 ≤ R ≤ cnt and 0 ≤ X ≤ 1015.
![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5f9a3eda18f3a09bbf898be93ace22143cf6584a.png) denotes bitwise XOR of a and b.
It is guaranteed that at least one query of type 2 exists.
output: Output the answer to each query of second type in separate line.
note: - Query 1: 1 1 1, Node 2 with weight 1 is added to node 1.
- Query 2: 2 2 0, No sequence of nodes starting at 2 has weight less than or equal to 0. last = 0
- Query 3: 2 2 1, Answer is 1 as sequence will be {2}. last = 1
- Query 4: 1 2 1, Node 3 with weight 1 is added to node 2.
- Query 5: 2 3 1, Answer is 1 as sequence will be {3}. Node 2 cannot be added as sum of weights cannot be greater than 1. last = 1
- Query 6: 2 3 3, Answer is 2 as sequence will be {3, 2}. last = 2

input.ai: 第一行包含查询数量 Q (1 ≤ Q ≤ 400000)。
设 last 为上一次类型 2 查询的答案（初始时 last 等于 0）。
接下来的 Q 行每行包含一个如下形式的查询：

1 p q (1 ≤ p, q ≤ 10^18)：这是第一种类型的查询，其中 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/23caaf5370a4d35b830e404cf70088925e1a9749.png) 和 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/92f7f390372274897cb1fbe68b8e5fcbbbd9710c.png)。保证 1 ≤ R ≤ cnt 且 0 ≤ W ≤ 10^9。

2 p q (1 ≤ p, q ≤ 10^18)：这是第二种类型的查询，其中 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/23caaf5370a4d35b830e404cf70088925e1a9749.png) 和 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/07ae7521dbc6857c85e4d6cc6df38a9db5a96d28.png)。保证 1 ≤ R ≤ cnt 且 0 ≤ X ≤ 10^15。
![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5f9a3eda18f3a09bbf898be93ace22143cf6584a.png) 表示 a 和 b 的按位异或。
保证至少存在一个类型 2 的查询。

output.ai: 将每个类型 2 查询的答案分别输出在单独一行。

note.ai: - 查询 1：1 1 1，将权值为 1 的节点 2 添加到节点 1。
- 查询 2：2 2 0，不存在从节点 2 开始且权值小于或等于 0 的节点序列。last = 0
- 查询 3：2 2 1，答案为 1，因为序列将为 {2}。last = 1
- 查询 4：1 2 1，将权值为 1 的节点 3 添加到节点 2。
- 查询 5：2 3 1，答案为 1，因为序列将为 {3}。不能添加节点 2，因为权值之和不能大于 1。last = 1
- 查询 6：2 3 3，答案为 2，因为序列将为 {3, 2}。last = 2

legend.ai: 给定树中编号为 1 且权值为 0 的一个节点。设 cnt 为任意时刻树中的节点数（初始时 cnt 为 1）。支持 Q 次以下两种类型的查询：
![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3c53d1886cd6252f58663221e2b5768b1981acff.png) 添加一个权值为 W 的新节点(编号为 cnt + 1)，并在节点 R 与该节点之间添加一条边。
![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3ca7b8a948d44b13bf24c54f54602fe3dbc94f6d.png) 输出以 R 开头的节点序列的最大长度。
序列中的每个节点都是其前一个节点的祖先。
序列中节点的权值之和不超过 X。
对于序列中相邻的节点 i、j，若 i 是 j 的祖先，则 w[i] ≥ w[j]，并且从 i 到 j 的简单路径上不存在满足 w[k] ≥ w[j] 的节点 k。
在任意时刻，树都以节点 1 为根。
注意，查询以修改后的方式给出。
